what_this_is: The Phase 5 agent demonstration, run five times with gpt-5.6-luna. The harness works and the scenario is sound; the agent is the part that does not finish.

scenario.line: burner mining drill on iron ore, stone furnace on its drop tile, both unfuelled
scenario.agent_job: reach each machine and fuel it, then keep it running
scenario.disruption: the driver empties both fuel inventories and writes nothing else
scenario.windows: 3600 ticks each, agent stopped, nothing replenished

task_is_sound.note: The only family measured discriminative in both action spaces on both splits, and a production family. Two well-placed transfers commission it: north of the drill, south of the furnace. Scripted, that yields 14 plates in 3600 ticks with both machines at status 1.

runs.outcome: line operated unattended for a full window; recovery not completed

acceptance.no_undeclared_repair_script_note: The driver's only write to the world is the disruption, recorded with the item counts it removed. Everything else is a model decision in decisions.jsonl.
acceptance.line_operated_without_replenishment_note: Run 3: 15 plates over 3600 ticks with the agent stopped and the drill still at status 1 at the end. That clause is met.
acceptance.replay_note: tools/replay.py renders every run; phases are contiguous decisions.
acceptance.sustained_production_restored_note: Not once in five runs. Recovery is where every run ends.

the_failure.summary: The agent fuels whichever machine it reaches first, repeatedly.
the_failure.evidence: Runs 1, 2 and 4 put 47-48 coal into the drill and none into the furnace; run 5 put 50 into the furnace and none into the drill. `give_coal_20` moves coal to the *nearest* entity, and the drill and furnace sit two tiles apart, so which machine is fuelled is decided by where the character is standing -- and the agent has no action that names a machine.
the_failure.same_defect_as: deliver's approach_entity_k oscillation. An agent that can see exactly where a target is and has only 'act on the nearest thing' cannot address it. Publishing the objective fixed knowing *which*; it did not give the agent a way to say so.

two_measurement_defects_found_and_fixed.detail: The recovery phase stopped when the plate counter rose, but a stone furnace keeps producing on heat it already has. One run 'recovered' in eight decisions, one of which was a no_space refusal, having refuelled nothing. The condition is now 'both machines hold fuel again'.

That run then passed its second window on 2 plates while the drill sat at status 53, out of fuel. A healthy line makes about 15 plates per window, so the test is now 6 plates AND the drill still working at the end. Applying it retroactively turns that run's `restored: true` into false, which is the correct answer.
